prototypeNotes: This ledger begins empty and contains no fabricated review evidence.
A checklist result cannot pass until its required evidence records are validated and current.
Candidate decision templates never count as formal decision evidence.
Source references must support the reviewed identity without embedding raw sourcebook text.
Any relevant source, catalog, decision, fixture, test, or checklist fingerprint change marks dependent evidence stale.
Chronicle owns evidence validation, staleness detection, fingerprints, diagnostics, status calculation, and promotion enforcement.
Assigned reviewers own evidence submission and the substantive accuracy of source-backed review claims.
